heroAnswer: Piqua was built on the river, drowned by the river, and rebuilt against it — and its houses are old enough to remember all three. We serve Piqua with free inspections, transparent pricing, and photo-documented work.
intro: Piqua is our service area's oldest town: median build 1953, 77.0% of homes built before 1980, 36.4% pre-1939 — the largest pre-war core. Surveyed in 1807 as Washington, renamed Piqua in 1816, incorporated in 1823. The 1913 flood's deadliest day took 44 lives in Shawnee; the town has lived behind MCD levees (finished 1922) with Lockington Dam upstream ever since. No Piqua tornado is claimed — the storm story is the river.
